# Simon Amor

> Simon Amor is a designer and co-founder of Morse, previously at Spotify and Monzo. This is his portfolio of product design work and creative experiments.

## Portfolio

- [Interactive portfolio](https://www.simonamor.design/): Work and Fun collections, with List and Card views. List rows show image, video or prototype previews on hover.
- [Product design project index](https://www.simonamor.design/work): Public project titles grouped by Morse, Sling, Spotify, Monzo and client projects.
- [Morse projects](https://www.simonamor.design/work#morse): Card, Investments, Savings, Bill Splits, Bill Pay and Growth.
- [Spotify projects](https://www.simonamor.design/work#spotify): Group Sessions, Enhance, privacy controls, local files and offline listening, and short form video music discovery.
- [Monzo projects](https://www.simonamor.design/work#monzo): Shared Tabs, Golden Tickets, Salary Sorter, Get paid early, Bills Pots and Premium paid account.
- [Terminal experiment](https://www.simonamor.design/about): A personal interactive animation experiment, not a biographical About page.

## Context

Simon has built products for clients including Google, Android, YouTube and NatWest. Selected client projects also include AI particle tracking for researchers. Locked client previews are blurred; this portfolio does not publish their private case study details. Items awaiting media say Coming soon.
